name: Bright light makes emotions stronger
claim: In six studies, brighter room light made people feel warmer and made their emotional reactions stronger, both good and bad.
caveat: Bright light raised the strength of emotion, not its pleasure; the lux values were not seen.

sources.title: Xu and Labroo 2014, Incandescent affect: turning on the hot emotional system with bright light, Journal of Consumer Psychology 24(2)
